text:
Maya: dropping a prototype for the scorecard multi-select + sticky approve toolbar. goal: let reviewers triage multiple diffs quickly without leaving keyboard. link to Figma screenshot.
Lucas: Nice! first UX thought: toolbar should stick to bottom of viewport, not the panel, so it doesn't cover details. show a small shadow and a compact summary (e.g., 3 selected).
Diego: Accessibility: selected count should be live-updated via aria-live so screen readers hear "3 items selected". also each row's checkbox needs aria-label like "Select diff: signup_flow prompt set".
Sofia: Bulk approve copy: instead of just "Approve", label the CTA "Approve selected as resolved". Add confirmation toast with Undo for 7s. If any selected diffs are critical, show an extra warning in the modal: "Includes critical diffs".
Pri: Keyboard shortcuts: propose `Shift+Space` to toggle current row selection, `A` to open bulk action menu, `Ctrl/Cmd+Enter` to approve selection. Put a small keyboard cheat sheet under the toolbar (collapsible).
Maya: Good recs. UX nuance: when selection spans pages/filters, show a subtle note "Selection includes 12 items across 3 pages" and add actions: "Select all matching" / "Clear selection".
Lucas: Visual design: selected rows get a 2px left accent and a mild background tint. Ensure contrast for tint meets 3:1. For high-contrast mode use a dashed left border instead.
Diego: Screen reader flow for bulk approve modal: when opened announce "Bulk approve 3 diffs. Confirm or press Escape to cancel." Trap focus and make action buttons first in tab order. After approval announce which diffs were approved by id.
Sofia: Copy nits: the confirm button should read "Approve 3 diffs" rather than ambiguous verbs. When mixed severities exist show inline text: "Including 1 critical — review required" with a link to view only criticals.
Pri: Edge case: concurrent state changes 
— if someone else resolves a diff mid-selection show a toast: "1 item already resolved. Selection updated." and adjust selection list. Offer a view to review conflicts.
Maya: Mobile: toolbar becomes a bottom sheet with primary approve button and a small summary. Buttons should be full width and 48px tall min. Selection chips collapse into a single counter to save space.
Lucas: Performance: don't render the full diff content for unselected rows. Use placeholders and only hydrate detail panes for focused/expanded rows. Helps big eval runs.
Diego: a11y polish: when user hits `A` to open bulk actions announce available actions. Add `aria-controls` linking toolbar to the list region. Also ensure checkboxes are large enough for touch and have appropriate labels.
Sofia: Scorecard integration: add deep-link from toast e.g., "View approved in scorecard" that anchors to the first approved diff. Also track audit events for bulk approves in the timeline.
Pri: Mini-UX ask: add a safety toggle in settings to require modal confirmation for bulk approves >N (default 10). Helpful for orgs that want stricter controls.
EvalBot: automated note  eval run 2107 attached. summary: 24 diffs, 6 regressions. backend PR #621 will expose bulk-selection endpoints and audit payloads.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll update the Figma to include sticky bottom toolbar, keyboard cheat sheet, live region examples, and the bulk confirm modal copy. Will post a spec PR with aria snippets and the small settings toggle. Ping me for quick review. :sparkles:
